claims_to_verify: Own opinions, no numbers or citations. Swaps follow our tier lists: upright row and behind-the-neck pulldown (back F), db flys (chest C) → seated cable fly (chest A), bosu ball squat (legs F) → leg press (legs #1), 21s (biceps F) → incline db curl (biceps A), crunches → hanging leg raise (LW-CAR-0024 abs pick).
